Do not add telemetry, spend, credentials, domains, deployments, dependencies, or monetization changes.

Retain the three previously reviewed reversible candidates as deferred specifications only: saveusfarms.com metadata refresh, fishhooklabs.com guide discoverability improvement, and 0xroulette.com CTA clarity. Reassess only after an active delivery slot clears and containment obligations are complete. Do not create duplicate work or claim revenue or causal lift.

Retain an execution-integrity control-plane concept for future evaluation: deduplicate approved work, expose slot ownership and blockers, prevent site overlap, and link each approved proposal to one auditable implementation and measurement outcome. This is a deferred product specification, not an implementation request, and must not be admitted while current capacity and evidence gates remain blocked.
